sarah: Running the eval-harness locally with `--interactive` and `--validate`. Hit a weird one — preflight prints a bunch of quantization warnings but exits 0. Repro: `./tools/eval run --model ./out/q8_model --interactive --validate`

jason: I saw that last week with the 8-bit experiment. It prints:```
WARN: quantize mismatch: expected 16bit range, got 8bit fallback
WARN: kv-cache size truncated
```
but process exit was `0` so CI treated it as success. :eyes:

priya: Oof. I think we treat warnings as soft by default; but that breaks local dev feedback loop. Suggest adding a `--strict` flag that promotes warnings to non-zero exit code. Also docs should say what counts as warning vs error.

morgan: CI side — our pipeline relies on `eval --validate` as a pre-step. If it returns 0 but prints serious model-quality warnings we silently merge bad configs. We need a stable exit code mapping: 0=ok, 1=runtime error, 2=validation-warning, 3=validation-fail. That way CI can `test ! exitcode -eq 2` or similar.

jason: Agree. Small UX nit: `--interactive` currently loops and prints the same warnings between prompt cycles. Makes it noisy. Maybe print a single summarized banner at start and on model reload only.

dev-bot: preflight-lint check: last run 2026-02-12 14:02 UTC — found 12 quantization warnings on q8_model-2026-02-11. See: https://ci.redwood/1234/logs

priya: Another idea: add a `--validation-summary` output, JSON/CSV modes, so local devs can grep the keys they care about. Example: `./tools/eval run --validate --summary=json > summary.json`

morgan: For CI we can add `eval --validate --fail-on warnings` as preflight step for model-onboarding jobs. But we need consistent exit codes first.

jason: Minimal patch: (1) add `--strict` alias `--fail-on warnings`, (2) ensure exit code 2 for warnings, 3 for fatal validation failures, (3) dedupe warning banner in interactive mode. I can sketch this today.

sarah: Thanks. Can we also update CLI `--help` to document the new flags and include short examples? Current help is one-liner and misses the validation semantics.

priya: Docs: add "Validation and exit codes" section under devex/eval-harness docs, with small table and example CI snippet. I'll draft it.

jason: Quick local debug snippet I used:```bash
export EVAL_DEBUG=1
./tools/eval run --model ./out/q8_model --validate --summary=text
```
It prints a compact table and the raw warnings once.

morgan: CI note: once we have exit-codes stable, I'll update onboarding job in `infra/ci/models.yml` to `onboarding: preflight: cmd: ./tools/eval run --validate --fail-on=warnings`

ci-bot: Pipeline status: onboarding-2026-02-19 failed earlier due to unrelated flake; waiting for validation-exitcode PR.

sarah: I'll open PR to normalize exit codes + add `--strict` + dedupe banners. Link in thread when up. Assigning to @sarah. :+1:

jason: pls add unit tests for exit code mapping and a small integration test that runs `./tools/eval run --validate --summary=json` and checks `code in [0,2,3]`.

sarah: Will do. Planning to land small patch + docs + CI change in a single PR to avoid dead time. Expecting to open by EOD.

morgan: sounds good. thanks!

sarah: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-harness/pull/789 (WIP)

priya: I'll review docs once PR is up.

jason: thx, will test locally when you post the branch.
